name: Arctic Vigor

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

text:
This tattoo takes the shape of the face of a roaring polar bear with piercing, ice-blue eyes. You don't take damage from extreme cold or severe cold.

---

Activate 2 command

Frequency once per day

---

Effect You call forth a blast of polar wind in a 10-foot burst within a range of 30 feet that deals 7d6 cold damage. All creatures in the area must attempt a DC 27 basic Fortitude save save.
